jobs_results.title: Solutions Architect (he/she/they)
jobs_results.description:
Do you know NTT DATA? Our company is a large multinational Technological consultancy. You can see more in our web https://es.nttdata.com/.

But, did you know that we also develop our own products?

We have developed a product ecosystem, a series of products that can be used separately or together and complement each other to provide better tools for our clients who use them.

We have called this product ecosystem: Syntphony, a world where every element is willing and ready to play with each others to improve the final result. To learn more about our products visit https://www.syntphony.com/

Join our NTT DATA Products & Assets division as a Solutions Architect, your mission will involve crafting cutting-edge tech solutions for our clients and evaluating our product's technical strengths. We are looking for someone who has wide knoledge in technologies and is able to adapt to different tech environment.

Your responsibilities
• Design and implement technical solutions to address... product requirements.
• Develop complex systems architecture.
• Advise on tech and IT strategies to support business goals.
• Review and assess product lifecycle and architecture.
• Conduct product interviews, identify improvement areas, and provide actionable advice.
• Elaborate assessments for existing products following NTT Data P&A methodology including recommendations to make products more secure, scalable, resilient and operable.
• Stay updated on industry practices and trends.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience.
• Experience in a Solutions Architect role, ideally in software.
• Deep understanding of software development, including design and operations.
• Knowledge of distributed systems, cloud technologies, security, and resilience principles.
• Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent communication skills, able to relay complex information simply.
• Independent, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks.
• Leadership qualities, with a talent for guiding and influencing teams.
• English B2-C1 to be able of communicate and collaborate with teams around the world.

Being part of our company means

💼👩💻 Long term contract with our flexible compensation program (ticket restaurant, nursery or transport card), AyudaFlex extra in your salary to cover remote working expenses and Health insurance (you could include your family).

🚀 Individualized continuous growth plan aligned with your interests

👩🎓👨🎓 From our Corporate University you can carry out Certifications, language courses and much more.

🤗 Work in a good team environment where you can learn from others and they from you.

⏱👩💻 Flexible work model with flexible time table and intensive journey on Friday and summer time (from 01-07 to 15-09)

🏡 Remote working, making it easier to fit your hobbies and other activities into your day to day and work from home allowance (chair, keyboard, mouse, screen...)

At NTT DATA, we believe everyone is unique and different, this is why we bet for an inclusive culture that recognizes and values diversity. We work day after day to create an environment in wich we can explore, live and enhance our own singularity.

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique

jobs_results.title: MMSS - AX/F&O - Solution Architect
jobs_results.description:
Resumen

En Prodware nos encontramos en un periodo de fuerte crecimiento 🚀 y estamos buscando gente como tú para que formes parte de nuestro equipo de especialistas.

Prodware España es el partner tecnológico de referencia para la implantación de soluciones basadas en Microsoft Dynamics 365, F&O, PP, CE, BC, O365, Power BI... en el mercado español. Con más de 20 años de experiencia ofreciendo a nuestros clientes servicios de consultoría tecnológica contamos con la plantilla de especialistas más consolidada de España.

Como parte de este crecimiento de Prodware España estamos buscando incorporar un/a Solution Architect de Dynamics 365 F&O para el area de Servicios Gestionados, ubicado/a en España, que combine pasión por la tecnología, audacia, y confianza.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

📚 Programa de formación y aprendizaje continuas. ¡Tendrás acceso a certificaciones de Microsoft!

💻 Posibilidad de trabajar de forma remota.

🕓 Flexibilidad horaria.

📅 ¡Todos los viernes en jornada... intensiva!

🏝️ ¡Julio y agosto disfrutaras de todas las tardes libres!

💳 Retribución flexible

🎊 Eventos de empresa. ¡Nos gusta divertirnos!

🎟️ Podrás asistir a eventos organizados por Microsoft.

🚀 Te ofrecemos un entorno dinámico, en el que tu plan de carrera y crecimiento será nuestro objetivo.

💝 Buen ambiente de trabajo, abiertos e inclusivos.

Tenemos un gran desafío de crecimiento por delante y estamos dispuestos a recorrer ese camino contigo. ¡Somos conscientes que esto no lo conseguiremos sin las personas de nuestro equipo!

¿Te unes a nosotros?

Responsabilidades

¿Qué harás?
• Asegurarás la calidad y la estructura de la solución.
• Coordinarás la solución entre las diferentes áreas del proyecto.
• Identificarás oportunidades de mejora de procesos.
• Dirigirás sesiones de brainstorming para desarrollar posibles soluciones para las necesidades o problemas del negocio.
• Colaborarás con los consultores en el diseño de los requisitos de prueba.
• Identificarás las áreas en las cuales poder respaldar y apoyar en las necesidades y objetivos del negocio.
• Colaborarás con el área comercial para desarrollar y definir estrategias de IT y mejorar los procesos actuales.
• Realizarás formación al equipo.
• Gestionarás el riesgo y conflictos de los proyectos.
• Propondrás soluciones de calidad al cliente dentro del estándar.
• Asegurarás la solución de acuerdo con el ámbito de aplicación, los costes, el horario y la satisfacción del cliente.

Requisitos

¿Qué conocimientos requerimos?
• Experiencia de 8 años como consultor de Dynamics AX o Dynamics 365 F&O.
• Experiencia como responsable de la implantación y conocimiento funcional de diferentes módulos del ERP.
• Conocimiento de herramientas para crear mapas de procesos de negocio.

Valorable:
• Nivel alto de inglés

jobs_results.title: Solutions Architect
jobs_results.description:
From Hays, we are collaborating with a leading telecommunications company in Europe and the US. They are expanding the team looking for experienced Solution Architect to join an international team.

What will you do?
• The ideal candidate will be responsible for working cross-functionally to understand architecture needs by multiple business units. To be effective in this position, you must feel comfortable owning the entire architecture development process from inception to completion.
• Lead architecture initiatives from inception to completion
• Collaborate with business users to create architecture in alignment with business need
• Contribute to the Definition, Design, Implementation, Rollout and the Governance of the Architecture Vision
• Develop architectural concepts/structures, including the development of technical concepts taking into account holistic business requirements and implications
• Define and communicate the Architecture Roadmap of Entire Solution of the projects
•... Give to the development teams a clear Description of the Architecture Requirements

You will succeed if you have:
• Understanding of Cloud Architecture, CI/CD and Software Architecture & Design
• Solid Knowhow of Micro Service Rest Architecture, DevOps Practices; AIOps
• Excellent communication Skills
• Fluent English

What we offer:
• Contract with final client
• International work environment
• Remote work model
• Flexible working schedule

jobs_results.title: Automation Solutions Architect
jobs_results.description:
Join a Thriving Financial Services Team in Sunny Valencia!

Looking for an exciting career move in the heart of Valencia, Spain? Here’s your chance! Our client, renowned for tailored financial services in private equity and fund investment, seeks a visionary Automation Solutions Architect to join their dynamic team permanently.

Why You?

You’ll spearhead our automation revolution, driving the analysis, design, and deployment of cutting-edge BPM/RPA solutions. If you’re a seasoned MS Power Platform Developer with over 2 years of hands-on automation expertise, this role was made for you!

Responsibilities:
• Lead custom MS Power Platform solutions from conception to execution.
• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to identify pain points and align automation solutions with business objectives.
• Develop and deploy innovative automation solutions that transform operations.
• Showcase tailored technology demos to our executive team and users.
• Prepare compelling... demonstrations and user-friendly training materials to showcase and facilitate adoption of automation tools.
• Advise on best practices, governance, and standards for Power Platform.
• Collaborate with external experts to drive project success.
• Analyze business processes, recommend enhancements, and implement streamlined automation solutions to optimize efficiency.

Requirements:
• 2+ years of experience in project management, system design, or information systems
• At least 2 years of direct automation experience.
• Understanding of Business Process Management (BPM) and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) methodologies.
• Exp with Office 365 - mainly SharePoint
• Hands-on experience with Power Platform technical solutions: Canvas and Model-Driven Power Apps, Power Automate Cloud

Conditions:
• Hybrid working model in vibrant Valencia.
• Competitive salary: €30k – €45k / year.
• Permanent contract with a forward-thinking company.

Ready to Make Your Mark?

Don’t miss out—send us your CV today to seize this incredible opportunity!

If this role isn’t quite right for you, explore similar opportunities on our website: www.allenrec.com

You can also contact us under info@allenrec.com or +34 919 030 009.

Job Reference: 25195
